use.reason: The unchanged Mellin calculation gives the newform sign. Atkin–Lehner bad newform coefficients and Silverman bad elliptic factors are0 or±1, so the finite ratio is holomorphic and nonzero at1. Matching good factors then gives equal central orders, and the two functional equations give equal signs. Full L-function equality and equality of special values are not asserted.
use.shared_contract_justification: One fixed primitive form and one determinant slash normalization throughout.

supplier.statement: For the associated primitive form and elliptic curve with matching good factors, nonzero bad-factor denominators at1 give equal central vanishing orders; their functional equations therefore have the same sign, namely minus the product of the exact-prime-power Atkin eigenvalues.
